title: No compensation.
bodyText: The commissioners shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for reasonable expenses, including travel expenses, incurred in the discharge of their duties.
bodyHtml: [§11-313]  No compensation.  The commissioners shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for reasonable expenses, including travel expenses, incurred in the discharge of their duties. [L 2010, c 211, pt of §2]
